SELECTED_INDEX: 8
CONFIDENCE: 0.65
EXPLANATION: The strong band at 2117 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a C≡C stretch; the absence of a ≡C–H stretch near ~3300 cm⁻¹ indicates an internal alkyne rather than a terminal one, favoring candidate 8 over 2. No band appears near ~2220–2260 cm⁻¹, which disfavors all nitrile-bearing candidates (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7). The prominent aliphatic C–H stretches at 2888/2946/2989 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1454 cm⁻¹ match saturated ring/alkyl features (supported by GFQ-003). The remaining mid-frequency bands (860–963 cm⁻¹ and ~700 cm⁻¹) are plausible ring/skeletal modes for a cycloalkyl-alkyne, consistent with CCC#CC1CC(C)C1.
